# output, stored in the repo (referenced rather than embedded — it can be hundreds of KB):
ASMLIFT_PATH='/path/to/asmlift'

    sll	$a0, $a0, 0x10
    sra	$a0, $a0, 0x10
    sll	$v0, $a0, 0x3
    addu	$v0, $v0, $a0
    sll	$v0, $v0, 0x2

    sll	$v0, $v0, 0x4

# The project context the benchmark passed via --context: the VERBATIM vendored blob — this
# function's translation unit run through the project's own preprocessor without the function, and
# nothing added (where that preprocessor is CodeWarrior's, every other function body is removed too,

gunzip -kc "$ASMLIFT_PATH/apps/benchmark/dataset/real/tu/marioparty3/ctx-3f9d594d88fa.i.gz" > ctx.h

python3 "$M2C_PATH/m2c.py" "${args[@]}" in.s

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Reproduce m2c on `UnlinkProcess` — benchmark function marioparty3:UnlinkProcess:gcc2.7.2.
set -euo pipefail

#   git clone https://github.com/matt-kempster/m2c && git -C m2c checkout 708d2d2cb2698f091a92492b328f73b24209f72d
M2C_PATH='/path/to/m2c'
# asmlift checkout — this function's context is the project's own vendored preprocessor
# output, stored in the repo (referenced rather than embedded — it can be hundreds of KB):
ASMLIFT_PATH='/path/to/asmlift'

# The benchmark's objdump→GNU-as normalization of this function's disassembly (m2c cannot
# read raw objdump), including the jump-table/const data sections recovered from the target
# object — the exact text the benchmark fed m2c.
cat > in.s <<'ASM_INPUT'
glabel UnlinkProcess
    lw	$v1, 0($a1)
    beqz	$v1, .L14
    nop
    lw	$v0, 4($a1)
    sw	$v0, 4($v1)
.L14:
    lw	$v1, 4($a1)
    beqz	$v1, .L2c
    nop
    lw	$v0, 0($a1)
    j	.L34
    sw	$v0, 0($v1)
.L2c:
    lw	$v0, 0($a1)
    sw	$v0, 0($a0)
.L34:
    jr	$ra
    nop
    nop
ASM_INPUT

# The project context the benchmark passed via --context: the VERBATIM vendored blob — this
# function's translation unit run through the project's own preprocessor without the function, and
# nothing added (where that preprocessor is CodeWarrior's, every other function body is removed too,
# because m2c reads only declarations and cannot parse CodeWarrior's inline asm). How much that is
# varies by project (a full header tree for some, a handful of typedefs for others); the file below
# is the exact bytes, so read it rather than this comment.
# One line is appended: the function's own prototype, and ONLY because the project's headers do
# not declare it and the row's asmlift `--proto` already carries the same void-ness. It is
# derived from that field, never from the reference source.
gunzip -kc "$ASMLIFT_PATH/apps/benchmark/dataset/real/tu/marioparty3/ctx-0eb9f921480c.i.gz" > ctx.h
cat >> ctx.h <<'CTX_PROTO'
void UnlinkProcess();
CTX_PROTO

  --target mips-gcc-c     # ISA + compiler dialect (selects m2c's code-shape assumptions)
  --function UnlinkProcess # the symbol to decompile from in.s
  --context ctx.h         # the project context header written above
  --no-cache              # bypass m2c's on-disk cache — always a fresh run
)
python3 "$M2C_PATH/m2c.py" "${args[@]}" in.s
